# name: set-moebius-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Inverse.moebius_bijOn
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, "have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0), Set.BijOn (fun x => (x - a) / (x + a)) {x | x ≠ -a} {y | y ≠ 1} ∧ (∀ y, y ≠ 1 → (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) - a) / (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) + a) = y) ∧ (∀ x, x ≠ -a → a * (1 + (x - a) / (x + a)) / (1 - (x - a) / (x + a)) = x) := by
  intro a ha
  have back : ∀ y, y ≠ 1 → (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) - a) / (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) + a) = y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 1 - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hy)
    rw [div_sub' h1, div_add' _ _ _ h1, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1]
    rw [div_eq_iff (by intro h; apply ha; linear_combination h / 2)]
    ring
  have forth : ∀ x, x ≠ -a → a * (1 + (x - a) / (x + a)) / (1 - (x - a) / (x + a)) = x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : x + a ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (by linarith)
    rw [one_add_div h1, one_sub_div h1, mul_div_assoc', div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1]
    rw [div_eq_iff (by intro h; apply ha; linear_combination h / 2)]
    ring
  refine ⟨⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx x' hx' h => ?_, fun y hy => ⟨a * (1 + y) / (1 - y), ?_, back y hy⟩⟩, back, forth⟩
  · intro h
    have h1 : x + a ≠ 0 := fun h' => hx (by linarith)
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq h1] at h
    exact ha (by linarith)
  · rw [← forth x hx, ← forth x' hx']
    simp only at h
    rw [h]
  · intro h
    have h1 : 1 - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hy)
    rw [div_eq_iff h1] at h
    exact ha (by linarith)
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0), Set.BijOn (fun x => (x - a) / (x + a)) {x | x ≠ -a} {y | y ≠ 1} ∧ (∀ y, y ≠ 1 → (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) - a) / (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) + a) = y) ∧ (∀ x, x ≠ -a → a * (1 + (x - a) / (x + a)) / (1 - (x - a) / (x + a)) = x) := by
  intro a ha
  have back : ∀ y, y ≠ 1 → (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) - a) / (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) + a) = y := by
    intro y hy

    rw [div_sub' h1, div_add' _ _ _ h1, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1]
    rw [div_eq_iff (by intro h; apply ha; linear_combination h / 2)]
    ring
  have forth : ∀ x, x ≠ -a → a * (1 + (x - a) / (x + a)) / (1 - (x - a) / (x + a)) = x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : x + a ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (by linarith)
    rw [one_add_div h1, one_sub_div h1, mul_div_assoc', div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1]
    rw [div_eq_iff (by intro h; apply ha; linear_combination h / 2)]
    ring
  refine ⟨⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx x' hx' h => ?_, fun y hy => ⟨a * (1 + y) / (1 - y), ?_, back y hy⟩⟩, back, forth⟩
  · intro h
    have h1 : x + a ≠ 0 := fun h' => hx (by linarith)
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq h1] at h
    exact ha (by linarith)
  · rw [← forth x hx, ← forth x' hx']
    simp only at h
    rw [h]
  · intro h
    have h1 : 1 - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hy)
    rw [div_eq_iff h1] at h
    exact ha (by linarith)
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['-1', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0), Set.BijOn (fun x => (x - a) / (x + a)) {x | x ≠ -a} {y | y ≠ 1} ∧ (∀ y, y ≠ 1 → (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) - a) / (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) + a) = y) ∧ (∀ x, x ≠ -a → a * (1 + (x - a) / (x + a)) / (1 - (x - a) / (x + a)) = x) := by
  intro a ha
  have back : ∀ y, y ≠ 1 → (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) - a) / (a * (1 + y) / (1 - y) + a) = y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : 1 - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hy)
    rw [div_sub' h1, div_add' _ _ _ h1, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1]
    rw [div_eq_iff (by intro h; apply ha; linear_combination h / 2)]
    ring
  have forth : ∀ x, x ≠ -a → a * (1 + (x - a) / (x + a)) / (1 - (x - a) / (x + a)) = x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : x + a ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (by linarith)
    rw [one_add_div h1, one_sub_div h1, mul_div_assoc', div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1]
    rw [div_eq_iff (by intro h; apply ha; linear_combination h / 2)]
    ring
  refine ⟨⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx x' hx' h => ?_, fun y hy => ⟨a * (1 + y) / (1 - y), ?_, back y hy⟩⟩, back, forth⟩
  · intro h
    have h1 : x + a ≠ 0 := fun h' => hx (by linarith)
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq h1] at h
    exact ha (by linarith)
  · rw [← forth x hx, ← forth x' hx']
    simp only at h
    rw [h]
  · intro h
    have h1 : 1 - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hy)
    rw [div_eq_iff h1] at h
    exact ha (by linarith)
exact @key (-1) ((by norm_num))"),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
